rules.name: combined-var-slow-02-view-live-check
rules.sql: SELECT pg_get_viewdef('opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view'::regclass) LIKE '%view_fx_nc_factor%' AS reads_stored_fx, pg_get_viewdef('opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view'::regclass) LIKE '%fx_nc_factor_view%' AS still_joins_fx_view, pg_get_viewdef('opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view'::regclass) LIKE '%helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view%' AS still_joins_sp_view, length(pg_get_viewdef('opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view'::regclass)) AS viewdef_chars

SELECT id, author, filename, dateexecuted, exectype, left(md5sum, 8) AS md5 FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id ILIKE '%settle%' OR id ILIKE '%shape%' OR id ILIKE '%fx%factor%' OR id ILIKE '%recon%' ORDER BY dateexecuted DESC LIMIT 15
rules.explain: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(mtm_usd) AS s1, sum(mtm_nc) AS s2, sum(settle_delta_1) AS s3, sum(settle_vega_1) AS s4, sum(settle_theta) AS s5 FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'RMC' AND value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND UPPER(business_unit) = 'RMC' LIMIT 1) AND derivative_type NOT ILIKE 'fx%' AND subportfolio NOT ILIKE 'conso%' AND p1_name NOT ILIKE 'CM OR%'

expect.reason: the live view is v6 and reads the stored fx columns
